drk.text: Ravi begins as a village girl in The Dark, whose village and mother are killed by a plague of rats. She meets the baron's son, who teaches her a song to control the rats, and she commands them to kill the baron after finding him working on her mother's corpse, though the baron's boy is revived by his father's last spell.

At the peak of the Great War on Ulgrotha, Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, destroying both parties and causing the Great Destruction. She hides in a magical coffin in the Basalt Spire and is trapped in it for centuries, driven mad.

The vampire Baron Sengir frees Ravi, neither recognizing the other, and takes her to his castle as Grandmother Sengir and his tutor. On the eve of the Mending, Sengir and Ihsan leave Ulgrotha at the head of a vampire army, while Ravi stays and later defends Ulgrotha in the Phyrexian Invasion.
